page.title: API Access
page.subtitle: Where Toskar's API is reachable, and how it is secured.

probe.notReady: Health check responded, but the service is not ready.
probe.unreachable: Could not reach the API on this computer.
probe.openaiDown: Service is up, but the OpenAI-compatible endpoint did not respond.
probe.needsKey: Responding. Other devices need a valid API key.
probe.checkFailed: Could not check the API — is the local service running?

service.title: Service
service.lanHint: Use this computer's LAN IP with port <mono>{{port}}</mono> (for example <mono>https://192.168.x.x:{{port}}/v1</mono>).
service.httpsCustom: Encrypted with HTTPS, with your certificate <mono>{{short}}</mono>.
service.httpsTrust: A browser or app asks you to trust this certificate the first time. Check that its SHA-256 fingerprint starts with {{short}}.
service.httpsError: Your certificate couldn't be used, so Toskar's own is: {{error}}
service.docsBody: Toskar exposes an OpenAI-compatible API at <mono>/v1</mono>. Point clients at the endpoint above and send <header/> when Toskar is reachable from other computers. `/api/v1` and `/v1` both require that header. The LAN endpoint uses HTTPS, which encrypts traffic; a key alone does not encrypt plain HTTP.

lan.title: Local network access
lan.on: Other computers and devices on your network can connect.
lan.off: Only this computer can use Toskar. Turn this on so people you add, your phones and tablets, and apps on other computers can connect.
lan.notes: Changes apply right away. Apps on this computer need nothing. Test API only checks this computer — not reachability from other devices.
lan.confirmBody: People you add sign in from other computers with their username and password. Phones and tablets connect with a code, and apps and scripts with an API key.
lan.confirmHttp: Without HTTPS, passwords and keys aren't encrypted on your network.
lan.nobody: Nobody can connect from another computer yet. Add a person, connect a device, or create an API key for an app.
lan.needSomeone: Nobody could connect yet. Add the person who'll sign in first. They won't need a key.
lan.orKey: Or, for an app or script, create an API key:

who.peopleHow: Sign in with their username and password.
who.appsHow: Use an API key, created below.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Credentials for apps and devices that talk to Toskar.
keys.createHint: Give this key a name so you know what uses it.
keys.copyNow: Copy this secret now — it won't be shown again
keys.confirmRotate: Rotate “{{name}}”? The old secret stops working immediately.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{{name}}”? Apps using this key will lose access.

permissions.note: Requests can ask for less, never more. Over the network these limits always apply; on this computer they apply when the app sends this key.
permissions.pinnedHint: Every request answers with this profile and its topic controls, and can't name another profile or a model.

share.title: Use Toskar in other AI apps
share.description: Apps that support MCP can ask your local AI, list its models, and search your connected knowledge. Answers stay on your computers, and the local AI only uses tools that read.
share.needsKey: Toskar is open to your network, so apps need an API key. Create one below and put it where the settings say <key/>. The key's permissions apply.

where.claudeDesktop: In Claude Desktop, open Settings → Developer → Edit Config, add this, and restart Claude.
where.cursor: Add this to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (Cursor Settings → MCP → Add new global MCP server).
where.vscode: Run "MCP: Open User Configuration" from the Command Palette and add this.
where.other: Apps that connect to MCP servers by address use Streamable HTTP at this address. Apps that start a program use the command instead.

phones.title: Devices
phones.description: Phones, tablets, and TVs connected with a code. Each has its own key, which can chat and read lists but can't change this computer.
phones.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{name}}? It will need a new code to connect again.

remote.title: Access from anywhere
remote.body: Devices paired with this computer can reach it away from home. It answers only what they use, over HTTPS, to their keys.
remote.notes: Toskar asks your router to open port {{port}} while this is on, and closes it when it's off. If the router can't, forward the port to this computer and enter the address it's reached at, or use Tailscale.
remote.portMapping: Open a port on the router automatically

router.opened: Your router opened port {{port}} for this computer ({{method}}).
router.off: Toskar doesn't ask your router to open a port. Turn on “Open a port on the router automatically”, or forward port {{port}} by hand.
router.no_gateway: This computer couldn't find its router. Check its network connection.
router.no_answer: Your router didn't answer requests to open a port. Turn on UPnP or NAT-PMP in its settings, or forward port {{port}} to this computer by hand.
router.refused: Your router refused to open port {{port}}. Check its UPnP settings, or forward the port to this computer by hand.
router.port_taken: Port {{port}} is already forwarded to another device on your router. Choose another port below, or remove that forward on the router.
router.double_nat: Your router opened port {{port}}, but it sits behind another router (double NAT), so the port doesn't reach the internet. Forward the port on the outer router too, or use the relay.
router.carrier_nat: Your router opened port {{port}}, but your internet provider shares one address among many homes (carrier-grade NAT), so the port can't reach the internet. Use the relay.
router.no_public_address: Your router has no internet address of its own: your internet provider shares one among many homes (carrier-grade NAT), or another router sits in front of it, so no port on it can reach the internet. Use the relay. To connect directly, ask your provider for a public IPv4 address, or forward port {{port}} on the outer router.
router.relayOnly: Using the relay only: Toskar doesn't ask your router to open a port.

others.one: Another Toskar is running on this computer: {{name}}, version {{version}}, on port {{port}}, with its data in {{folder}} (process {{pid}}).
others.oneRemote: Another Toskar is running on this computer, with access from anywhere on too: {{name}}, version {{version}}, on port {{port}}, with its data in {{folder}} (process {{pid}}). Both connect to the relay as separate computers.
others.advice: Each copy has its own chats, models, and devices. If you didn't mean to run both, stop the other one, such as a copy started by hand while the installed service runs.

reach.direct: Reachable from anywhere at {{address}}. Your router opened the port ({{method}}).
reach.ipv6: Reachable from anywhere over IPv6 at [{{address}}]:{{port}}, if your router lets it in.
reach.manual: Reachable at {{address}}, the address you entered.
reach.carrierNat: Not reachable yet: your internet provider shares one address among many homes, so a router port can't reach this computer. Toskar's relay will handle this.
reach.noPort: Not reachable yet: the router didn't open port {{port}}. Forward it to this computer and enter the address, or use Tailscale.

check.reachableViaRelay: Reachable from outside your network, through the relay
check.unreachable: Not reachable from outside your network
check.route: This computer's route on the relay: {{route}}

reason.no_tunnel: This computer isn't connected to the relay right now.
reason.not_public: This address isn't on the internet, so devices away from home can't use it.
reason.unresolved: This name doesn't lead to an address.
reason.refused: The address answered, but nothing listens on this port. Check that the port is forwarded to this computer.
reason.timeout: Nothing answered from the internet. Another router in front of yours (double NAT) or a firewall may be blocking it.
reason.unreachable: The internet can't reach this address.
reason.tls: Something other than Toskar answered on this port.
reason.http: This computer answered, but not as expected.
reason.httpStatus: This computer answered, but not as expected (HTTP {{status}}).
reason.wrong_computer: A web server that isn't Toskar answered on this port. Forward the port to this computer.
reason.wrongToskar: {{name}} answered on this port instead of this computer. Forward the port to this one.

relayState.noToken: No relay yet: subscribe above, or in the Toskar app on your phone or tablet, or enter your organization's relay below.

error.CHECK_UNSUPPORTED: This relay can't check from outside yet.
error.CHECK_TOO_SOON: Checked less than a minute ago, so this is the latest result. You can check again in a minute.
error.NO_TOKEN: There's no relay token to check with yet.
error.RELAY_UNREACHABLE: The relay couldn't be reached to run the check.

check.nextSteps: Devices away from home can't reach this computer. Fix what's marked and check again, or use a relay, which works behind any router.
check.directOptional: Devices away from home get in through the relay, so nothing needs fixing. A direct way in is optional: it can make answers a little faster.

relay.title: Your organization's relay
relay.body: If your organization runs its own Toskar relay, enter its name and the enrollment secret your IT team gave you. Devices paired with this computer then reach it through that relay when nothing more direct works.
relay.name: Relay
relay.secretSaved: Saved. Paste a new one to replace it.

state.noToken: Enter the relay's enrollment secret to connect.
state.error: Can't connect to {{relay}} ({{code}}). Check the name and the enrollment secret.

subscription.title: Toskar's relay
subscription.offer: When nothing else reaches this computer, Toskar's relay does, for this computer and every device paired with it.
subscription.billing: Billed by Yeix.io LLC. Cancel any time.
subscription.soldOut: Toskar's relay isn't taking new subscriptions right now. Try again in a few days.
subscription.pending: Finish paying on the checkout page. Access from anywhere turns on here a few seconds after.
subscription.active: Subscribed. Toskar's relay reaches this computer when nothing else does.
subscription.activeApp: Subscribed in the Toskar app. Manage it in the store on your phone or tablet.
subscription.ended: Your subscription has ended. Subscribe again to keep using Toskar's relay.
subscription.endedOn: Access from anywhere ended on {{date}}. Subscribe again to keep using Toskar's relay.
subscription.endedInApp: Access from anywhere ended on {{date}}. Subscribe again in the Toskar app on your phone or tablet, and it covers this computer too.
subscription.error: Couldn't check the subscription with Toskar's relay ({{code}}). Toskar tries again on its own.
subscription.noPage: The billing page didn't open. Try again.
subscription.inAppOnly: This copy of Toskar is from the App Store, so subscribe in the Toskar app on your phone or tablet, and manage it in that device's store. Once it's bought there, it covers this computer too.
